_comment: Bigger continuation of the adjust_net fix: resumes from v_tau050_adjust/weights_3 (the first adjust_net-enabled run, 4 epochs on 800 images from only 2 of 17 C3VD sequences) and continues training on a more diverse 1650-image stratified sample spanning all 17 training sequences. Goal: close more of the AbsRel/RMSE gap with real additional convergence (adjust_net started from scratch and had very little training before), not another code change -- the honest baseline comparison showed the adjust_net fix helps but only modestly so far (AbsRel 0.633->0.627, a1 0.439->0.466, RMSE 8.708->8.508 on the GT-filtered 10-sequence eval), almost certainly because 4 epochs/800 images is a small fraction of the original recipe's 20 epochs on the full ~6600-image C3VD set.
